summary: npm package ships a Cloudflare-impersonation HTML page with obfuscated JavaScript
details: The tarball contains a single index.html that mimics a Cloudflare Turnstile 'Just a moment...' challenge page and embeds a large obfuscator.io-style script (hex-named identifiers and a string-array decoder). package.json lists index.html as main, declares no lifecycle scripts, and ships no JavaScript module, so npm install and require() of this package do not execute code on the installer's machine. The content is a browser-facing phishing/ClickFix page that only renders when the HTML is loaded in a browser, typically via a public npm CDN such as unpkg or jsDelivr; the package appears to use the npm registry as a hosting surface for that page rather than as a software library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
